reason: Prior measurements show the unchanged reference near 937–1106 GFLOP/s; the K-loop variants did not earn promotion, and their noisy paired results do not establish causes. I rank bounded A-panel packing first because it targets the full per-call transpose cost while retaining the existing four-tile mapping, though its benefit is uncertain. The counter move and grouped stores are smaller, localized tests; grouped-store assembler support needs confirmation. Packing B and its layout variant overlap, add work, and the B loads are already contiguous, so they rank low. Tail handling does not affect the timed n=512 path. All proposals remain unverified.
